query: UPDATE contacts SET deleted_at = now() WHERE pid = ANY($1) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT (marketing_consent <> 'never' OR merged_into_pid IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contacts m WHERE m.merged_into_pid = contacts.pid) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activities a WHERE a.subject_kind = 'contact' AND a.subject_pid = contacts.pid AND a.deleted_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deals d WHERE d.primary_contact_pid = contacts.pid AND d.deleted_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets t WHERE t.contact_pid = contacts.pid AND t.deleted_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM leads l WHERE l.contact_pid = contacts.pid AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nurture_enrollments n WHERE n.contact_pid = contacts.pid) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consent_events c WHERE c.contact_pid = contacts.pid) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attachments x WHERE x.subject_pid = contacts.pid) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM custom_field_values v WHERE v.subject_pid = contacts.pid)) RETURNING pid
